articles.title: Lucy Letby public inquiry findings set to be published
articles.description: The Thirlwall Inquiry has been investigating how concerns about killer nurse Letby were handled - and whether any babies might have lived if action was taken earlier.

articles.title: Trump says AI safety fears a 'hoax' as he rejects calls for greater safeguards
articles.description: The US president's comments come after Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark told the BBC an AI "kill switch" may need to be mandatory.

articles.title: Chris Mason: Row over Reform's mega donations has mileage in it yet
articles.description: The £72m heading towards Reform UK's coffers is transforming the debate at Westminster about politics and money.

articles.title: Welsh actor Matthew Rhys makes Emmy Awards history with double win
articles.description: He becomes the first person to win two lead acting prizes in one night at the prestigious TV ceremony.
